mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_week_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as startDate, DATE_FORMAT(end_week_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as endDate FROM t_fixedlesson_status WHERE week_number = WEEKOFYEAR(#{baseDate}) AND #{baseDate} BETWEEN start_week_date AND end_week_date LIMIT 1

SELECT l.lesson_id, l.stu_id, s.stu_name as student_name, l.subject_id, sub.subject_name, COALESCE(subsub.subject_sub_name, '') as subject_sub_name, l.schedual_date, l.lsn_adjusted_date, l.class_duration, l.schedual_type FROM t_info_lesson l LEFT JOIN t_mst_student s ON l.stu_id = s.stu_id LEFT JOIN t_mst_subject sub ON l.subject_id = sub.subject_id LEFT JOIN t_info_subject_edaban subsub ON l.subject_id = subsub.subject_id AND l.subject_sub_id = subsub.subject_sub_id WHERE l.schedual_type = 1 AND DATE(l.schedual_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND l.lsn_adjusted_date IS NULL AND l.del_flg = 0 ORDER BY l.schedual_date

SELECT l.lesson_id, l.stu_id, s.stu_name as student_name, l.subject_id, sub.subject_name, COALESCE(subsub.subject_sub_name, '') as subject_sub_name, l.schedual_date, l.lsn_adjusted_date, l.class_duration, l.schedual_type FROM t_info_lesson l LEFT JOIN t_mst_student s ON l.stu_id = s.stu_id LEFT JOIN t_mst_subject sub ON l.subject_id = sub.subject_id LEFT JOIN t_info_subject_edaban subsub ON l.subject_id = subsub.subject_id AND l.subject_sub_id = subsub.subject_sub_id WHERE DATE(COALESCE(l.lsn_adjusted_date, l.schedual_date)) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND l.del_flg = 0 AND NOT ( l.schedual_type = 1 AND DATE(l.schedual_date) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND l.lsn_adjusted_date IS NULL ) ORDER BY COALESCE(l.lsn_adjusted_date, l.schedual_date)
